description: Lists accessible boards, most recently updated first. Account access returns personal boards unless organizationId is specified; guest access returns that session’s board. Continue with nextOffset until null, then use get_board for a selected board’s editable state. Guest access uses guestToken and excludes organization access.

guestToken.description: Private guest-session capability returned by start_guest_session. Never print it or save it in a repository.

limit.description: Maximum boards to return; defaults to 20.

offset.description: Zero-based offset; defaults to 0. Continue with returned nextOffset; null means no further page.

organizationId.description: Organization ID from list_organizations. Omit for personal account boards; guest sessions cannot use organizations.

name: list_boards
title: List boards
